description:
For just one night, a festival known as 'Yuk-yok-je' takes place—a night where people engage in wanton intimacy and unabashedly reveal their inner carnal desires. Ha Yeon-ri, the daughter of a fallen noble family serving as a palace maid, feels saddened by her bleak life and heads to the festival hoping to find a lover for a single night. There, she shares a night of passion with a wandering warrior who saves her. Contrary to her belief that it would be a one-time encounter, Yeon-ri returns to the palace only to reunite with the warrior from that hot night, who is actually Prince Ki Woo-won.

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14027091)
